edits.text: PARTIES. This Executive Employment Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into by and between Vireo Systems Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), and the Executive identified on the signature page hereto (the "Executive"), effective as of the date set forth on such signature page.
edits.name: Parties

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer of the Company and shall report to the Chief Executive Officer or such other officer or body as the Company may designate. The Executive shall devote substantially all business time, attention, and skill to the performance of the Executive's duties for the Company. Employment under this Agreement is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, subject to the express severance provisions of this Agreement.
edits.name: Position; at-will employment

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary as approved by the Board or its Compensation Committee from time to time (the "Base Salary"), less applicable withholdings and deductions, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in Company benefit plans generally available to similarly situated executives, subject to the terms of such plans. Any annual bonus or incentive compensation shall be discretionary unless separately approved in writing by the Board or its Compensation Committee and shall be subject to applicable plan terms and Company policies.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive's employment without Cause, and provided that the Executive timely executes and does not revoke a general release of claims in favor of the Company and continues to comply with the Executive's post-employment obligations, the Executive shall receive the severance amount approved in writing by the Board or its Compensation Committee (the "Severance Amount"), payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices. No severance shall be payable if the Executive resigns, is terminated for Cause, or fails to satisfy the conditions set forth in this Section.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During employment and for twelve (12) months after termination of employment, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in or assist a business that competes with the Company in any geographic area in which the Company conducts or has active plans to conduct business, in each case to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law. The Executive shall also comply with customary non-solicitation, confidentiality, non-disparagement, and intellectual property assignment obligations in favor of the Company. Nothing in this Agreement restricts the Executive from making reports to governmental agencies, responding to lawful process, or engaging in conduct protected by applicable law.
edits.name: Restrictive covenants

We can otherwise work from your draft if the reporting line remains to the CEO/Board only and any release condition includes mutual non-disparagement and does not forfeit vested/accrued rights.

I did not include any unrelated confidential deal threshold information.

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer of the Company and shall report solely to the Company's Chief Executive Officer and/or the Board of Directors of the Company (the "Board"). The Executive shall devote substantially all business time, attention, and skill to the performance of the Executive's duties for the Company, subject to customary exceptions for passive investments, civic and charitable activities, and outside activities approved by the Board, in each case so long as such activities do not materially interfere with the Executive's duties or create a conflict of interest. Employment under this Agreement is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, subject to the express severance provisions of this Agreement.
edits.name: Position; reporting line limited to CEO/Board

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $[●] (the "Base Salary"), less applicable withholdings and deductions, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices. The Base Salary shall be reviewed periodically and may be increased, but not decreased except for an across-the-board reduction applicable to similarly situated senior executives of the Company. The Executive shall be eligible to receive an annual target bonus opportunity equal to [●]% of Base Salary (the "Target Bonus"), with the actual amount, if any, determined based on achievement of performance goals established by the Board or its Compensation Committee and subject to the terms of the applicable bonus plan or written bonus arrangement. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in Company benefit plans generally available to similarly situated executives, subject to the terms of such plans.
edits.name: Fixed base salary and target bonus mechanics

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive's employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, then, provided that the Executive timely executes and does not revoke a general release of claims in favor of the Company in a form reasonably acceptable to the Company and continues to comply with the Executive's surviving obligations under this Agreement, the Executive shall receive: (a) continued payment of the Executive's then-current Base Salary for twelve (12) months, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices; (b) reimbursement or direct payment by the Company of the employer portion of COBRA premiums for up to twelve (12) months following termination, subject to the Executive's timely election of COBRA continuation coverage and continued eligibility; and (c) payment of any earned but unpaid annual bonus for any completed fiscal year preceding the termination date, payable when bonuses for such year are paid to similarly situated executives. No severance shall be payable if the Executive resigns without Good Reason, is terminated for Cause, or fails to satisfy the conditions set forth in this Section. For purposes of this Agreement, "Cause" means: (i) the Executive's conviction of, or plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony or crime involving fraud, dishonesty, or moral turpitude; (ii) willful misconduct or gross negligence in the performance of duties that materially harms the Company; (iii) material breach of this Agreement or any material Company policy; or (iv) fraud, embezzlement, or misappropriation involving the Company, in each case, where curable, after written notice and a reasonable opportunity of not less than thirty (30) days to cure. "Good Reason" means, without the Executive's written consent: (A) a material diminution in the Executive's authority, duties, or responsibilities; (B) a material diminution in Base Salary other than an across-the-board reduction applicable to similarly situated senior executives; (C) relocation of the Executive's principal place of employment by more than fifty (50) miles; or (D) the Company's material breach of this Agreement, including material nonpayment of compensation when due; provided that the Executive gives written notice within ninety (90) days after the initial occurrence of the condition, the Company fails to cure within thirty (30) days after receipt of such notice, and the Executive terminates employment within thirty (30) days after expiration of the cure period. The release required under this Section shall not waive vested benefits, accrued compensation, rights to indemnification, rights under directors' and officers' insurance, or rights that cannot be waived as a matter of law.
edits.name: Severance; Good Reason; accrued/vested rights carve-out

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall comply with the confidentiality, intellectual property assignment, non-disparagement, and non-solicitation obligations set forth in this Section, in each case subject to applicable law. The Executive shall not at any time use or disclose the Company's confidential information except in the course of performing duties for the Company or as otherwise permitted by law, and all inventions, works of authorship, developments, improvements, and other intellectual property created within the scope of employment or using Company confidential information or resources shall be assigned to the Company to the fullest extent permitted by law. During employment and for twelve (12) months after termination of employment, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly: (a) solicit for employment or engagement any employee or individual service provider of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the twelve (12) months preceding termination; or (b) solicit any customer, prospective customer, vendor, or business partner of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the twelve (12) months preceding termination for the purpose of diverting business that is competitive with the Company's business as conducted or actively planned as of the termination date. The foregoing restrictions shall not prohibit general solicitations not targeted at restricted persons or entities. The Company and the Executive shall not make statements that unlawfully or materially disparage the other; provided that this sentence shall not restrict truthful statements in response to lawful process, ordinary-course internal communications, or conduct protected by applicable law. Nothing in this Agreement restricts the Executive from making reports to governmental agencies, responding to lawful process, discussing terms and conditions of employment as protected by law, or engaging in any other conduct protected by applicable law.
edits.name: Restrictive covenants narrowed; no non-compete; mutual non-disparagement
